name: Tustin Teens in Action
org: City of Tustin Parks and Recreation Department
what_you_do: Volunteer to help supervise kids and run games and crafts. You also help at city events like Tustin Tiller Days, Halloween Howl and the Holiday Tree Lighting. You build leadership skills.
who_can_apply: High school students entering grades 9 to 12, ages 14 to 17. You need a recommendation letter. You also write 5 to 7 sentences about yourself.
duration: Monthly evening meetings. You volunteer at least 20 hours during the program year (June to May).
deadline_text: In the 2026 cycle, applications opened April 1, 2026 and closed May 1, 2026. The interview day was May 23, 2026. The next dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form. Add a recommendation letter. It can be academic, professional or athletic. Add a personal statement of 5 to 7 sentences. Mail it, email TPRD@tustinca.org, or drop it at City Hall, 300 Centennial Way. Then go to the orientation and interview.
notes: You apply once for each school year. The application form asks if you can attend meetings on Wednesday nights. City Hall Parks and Recreation phone: 714-573-3326.
